FIRST INFORMATION REPORT
(Under Section 154 Cr.P.C.)

1. District: South Delhi, Police Station: Saket
2. FIR No.: 0142/2023, Date & Time: 15-03-2023 at 11:30 hrs
3. Acts & Sections: Section 420, Section 406 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC)
4. Occurrence of Offence:
   - Date: 10-03-2023, Time: 14:30 hrs
   - Place: Office No. 402, Saket District Centre, New Delhi
5. Complainant / Informant:
   - Name: Vikramaditya Verma, S/o Late Shri R. K. Verma
   - Address: D-14, Saket, New Delhi
6. Details of Accused:
   - Name: Rajeshwar Sharma, R/o Sector 21, Noida, Uttar Pradesh
7. Brief Facts / Allegations:
   The complainant Vikramaditya Verma states that on 10-03-2023, the accused Rajeshwar Sharma fraudulently induced the complainant to invest an amount of Rs. 15,00,000 (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs) towards purchase of commercial property situated in Saket District Centre. The complainant transferred Rs. 15,00,000 via RTGS from his HDFC Bank account to the accused's account. Subsequent verification revealed that the title deeds provided by the accused were entirely forged and fabricated. When the complainant demanded refund of the amount, the accused refused and criminally misappropriated the funds.
8. Action Taken: Case registered under Section 420/406 IPC and assigned to Sub-Inspector Rakesh Nehra for investigation.
